gear-accessory#0000.src: Who would have thought to ever design something as pointlessly contrived and unusable as this? It's infuriating just to think about...
gear-accessory#0000.dst: Böylesine anlamsızca karmaşık ve kullanışsız bir şeyi tasarlamak kimin aklına gelirdi? Düşünmesi bile insanı çileden çıkarıyor...
gear-accessory#0000.flat: Who would have thought to ever design something as pointlessly contrived and unusable as this? It's infuriating just to think about...

gear-accessory#0001.src: "The fractures have ground the land to dust, our home to ruin, and our people to nothing."
gear-accessory#0001.dst: "Yarıklar toprağı toza, yurdumuzu harabeye, halkımızı hiçliğe öğüttü."
gear-accessory#0001.flat: "The fractures have ground the land to dust, our home to ruin, and our people to nothing."

gear-accessory#0002.src: Used by the Order of the Abyss to aid their summoning rituals, it contains a strange, fiery energy. It has ties with a terrible demon...
gear-accessory#0002.dst: Order of the Abyss'in çağırma ayinlerinde kullandığı bu muska tuhaf, ateşli bir enerji taşır. Korkunç bir iblisle bağı vardır...
gear-accessory#0002.flat: Used by the Order of the Abyss to aid their summoning rituals, it contains a strange, fiery energy. It has ties with a terrible demon...

gear-accessory#0004.src: The sea is the wisest of masters. It has been here for a million years since and will be here for a million years hence. Those who care to learn its secrets can become themselves enlightened. Stay by the waves a moment; they will fill your mind with wonder, if you are willing to listen.
gear-accessory#0004.dst: Deniz, ustaların en bilgesidir. Milyon yıldır buradadır, milyon yıl sonra da burada olacaktır. Sırlarını öğrenmeye gönül verenler aydınlanabilir. Bir an dalgaların yanında dur; dinlemeye razıysan zihnini hayretle dolduracaklar.
gear-accessory#0004.flat: The sea is the wisest of masters. It has been here for a million years since and will be here for a million years hence. Those who care to learn its secrets can become themselves enlightened. Stay by the waves a moment; they will fill your mind with wonder, if you are willing to listen.

gear-accessory#0005.src: {p} charms are often shared and tinkered with by gifted Elves within the commune. Though simple, the stones blessed by elven magic provide soothing energy to the wearer.
gear-accessory#0005.dst: {p} tılsımları, komündeki yetenekli Elfler arasında sık sık paylaşılır ve kurcalanır. Basit olsalar da elf büyüsüyle kutsanmış bu taşlar, takana dinlendirici bir enerji verir.
gear-accessory#0005.flat: {p} charms are often shared and tinkered with by gifted Elves within the commune. Though simple, the stones blessed by elven magic provide soothing energy to the wearer.
gear-accessory#0005._raw: Aldorei charms are often shared and tinkered with by gifted Elves within the commune. Though simple, the stones blessed by elven magic provide soothing energy to the wearer.

gear-accessory#0006.src: Enjoy the sun that has graced you with its longest daylight, and cherish it so that you can carry forth its warmth.
gear-accessory#0006.dst: Seni en uzun gün ışığıyla onurlandıran güneşin tadını çıkar ve onu öyle sevgiyle sakla ki sıcaklığını ileriye taşıyabilesin.
gear-accessory#0006.flat: Enjoy the sun that has graced you with its longest daylight, and cherish it so that you can carry forth its warmth.

gear-accessory#0007.src: A golden locket Afelis always carried with them. Inside is a picture of Afelis embracing a woman in the {p} square. 'A+E' is inscribed on the front.
gear-accessory#0007.dst: Afelis'in hep yanında taşıdığı altın bir madalyon. İçinde, Afelis'in {p} meydanında bir kadına sarıldığı bir resim var. Önünde 'A+E' kazılı.
gear-accessory#0007.flat: A golden locket Afelis always carried with them. Inside is a picture of Afelis embracing a woman in the {p} square. 'A+E' is inscribed on the front.
gear-accessory#0007._raw: A golden locket Afelis always carried with them. Inside is a picture of Afelis embracing a woman in the Detlas square. 'A+E' is inscribed on the front.

gear-accessory#0008.src: And lo, a single bolt did fly, ensured the bird's grace ever lost, and pierced its wings out from the sky, the day you shot the albatross.
gear-accessory#0008.dst: Ve işte tek bir ok uçtu, kuşun zarafetini sonsuza dek yitirtti, kanatlarını göğün ortasında deldi; o gün albatrosu vurdun sen.
gear-accessory#0008.flat: And lo, a single bolt did fly, ensured the bird's grace ever lost, and pierced its wings out from the sky, the day you shot the albatross.

gear-accessory#0009.src: Even looking at this pendant strains your eyes. Should it even exist?
gear-accessory#0009.dst: Bu kolyeye bakmak bile gözlerini yoruyor. Var olması doğru mu ki?
gear-accessory#0009.flat: Even looking at this pendant strains your eyes. Should it even exist?

gear-accessory#0010.src: "It's all doomed anyway. If you don't care, nothing can hurt you."
gear-accessory#0010.dst: "Zaten hepsi mahvolacak. Umursamazsan hiçbir şey seni incitemez."
gear-accessory#0010.flat: "It's all doomed anyway. If you don't care, nothing can hurt you."

gear-accessory#0011.src: This item was named by someone from the community!
gear-accessory#0011.dst: Bu eşyanın adını topluluktan biri koydu!
gear-accessory#0011.flat: This item was named by someone from the community!

gear-accessory#0012.src: "The lightest light will never defeat the darkest dark. Only those who understand both can survive."
gear-accessory#0012.dst: "En aydınlık ışık, en karanlık karanlığı asla yenemez. Yalnızca ikisini de anlayanlar hayatta kalabilir."
gear-accessory#0012.flat: "The lightest light will never defeat the darkest dark. Only those who understand both can survive."

gear-accessory#0013.src: Something must always rule the ecosystem, even one as warped as this.
gear-accessory#0013.dst: Bir şey her zaman ekosisteme hükmetmeli, bu kadar çarpık olsa bile.
gear-accessory#0013.flat: Something must always rule the ecosystem, even one as warped as this.

gear-accessory#0014.src: Inevitable, that your colors will fade and your hubris will cost you everything.
gear-accessory#0014.dst: Kaçınılmaz: renklerin solacak ve kibrin sana her şeye mal olacak.
gear-accessory#0014.flat: Inevitable, that your colors will fade and your hubris will cost you everything.

gear-accessory#0015.src: The jewel attached to this pendant glows blood red from the heat contained within, replicating a throbbing, volcanic heartbeat. One's soul is rejuvenated from the embers of your enemies caught in the burning ash of each pulse.
gear-accessory#0015.dst: Bu kolyeye takılı mücevher, içinde hapsolan sıcaklıktan kan kırmızısı parlar ve zonklayan, volkanik bir kalp atışını taklit eder. Her atımın yanan külüne yakalanan düşmanlarının közleriyle ruhun tazelenir.
gear-accessory#0015.flat: The jewel attached to this pendant glows blood red from the heat contained within, replicating a throbbing, volcanic heartbeat. One's soul is rejuvenated from the embers of your enemies caught in the burning ash of each pulse.

gear-accessory#0016.src: In the wake of the Decay, the land yearns to return to its old vibrance.
gear-accessory#0016.dst: Decay'in ardından toprak eski canlılığına dönmeyi özlüyor.
gear-accessory#0016.flat: In the wake of the Decay, the land yearns to return to its old vibrance.

gear-accessory#0017.src: May your triumphs live eternal and never fade.
gear-accessory#0017.dst: Zaferlerin sonsuza dek yaşasın, hiç solmasın.
gear-accessory#0017.flat: May your triumphs live eternal and never fade.

gear-accessory#0018.src: This pendant is not much more than a battery on a string, but a curious combination of Avos and electromagic seem to have left it with the ability to charge power from its surroundings on its own.
gear-accessory#0018.dst: Bu kolye ipe bağlı bir pilden pek fazlası değil, ama Avos ile elektrobüyünün tuhaf bir birleşimi ona çevresinden kendi kendine güç toplama yeteneği kazandırmış gibi.
gear-accessory#0018.flat: This pendant is not much more than a battery on a string, but a curious combination of Avos and electromagic seem to have left it with the ability to charge power from its surroundings on its own.

gear-accessory#0019.src: It was a timeless duel, a clash of titans. Two soldiers so similar, so powerful, yet irrevocably at odds. But in the end, a bent link torn from a coat of mail stands testimony: she stood no chance, the warrior in discord with her own blade.
gear-accessory#0019.dst: Zamansız bir düelloydu, devlerin çarpışması. Birbirine böylesine benzeyen, böylesine güçlü ama çaresizce karşı karşıya düşmüş iki asker. Sonunda bir zırh gömleğinden kopmuş eğri bir halka tanıklık eder: kendi kılıcıyla çatışan savaşçı kadının hiç şansı yoktu.
gear-accessory#0019.flat: It was a timeless duel, a clash of titans. Two soldiers so similar, so powerful, yet irrevocably at odds. But in the end, a bent link torn from a coat of mail stands testimony: she stood no chance, the warrior in discord with her own blade.

gear-accessory#0020.src: A deep rage settles upon you. An unquenchable fury at the world around you, and all its wretched failings.
gear-accessory#0020.dst: Derin bir öfke çöküyor üstüne. Etrafındaki dünyaya ve onun bütün sefil kusurlarına karşı dinmek bilmeyen bir hiddet.
gear-accessory#0020.flat: A deep rage settles upon you. An unquenchable fury at the world around you, and all its wretched failings.

gear-accessory#0021.src: An oppressively dark aura emanates from this shackle, dampening both the will and magic potency of those that wear it.
gear-accessory#0021.dst: Bu prangadan boğucu derecede karanlık bir aura yayılır; takanların hem iradesini hem de büyü gücünü köreltir.
gear-accessory#0021.flat: An oppressively dark aura emanates from this shackle, dampening both the will and magic potency of those that wear it.

gear-accessory#0022.src: Even simply looking at these odd rings gives way to a compulsion to wear two of them, despite all better judgement.
gear-accessory#0022.dst: Bu tuhaf yüzüklere sadece bakmak bile, bütün sağduyuna rağmen ikisini birden takma isteği uyandırıyor.
gear-accessory#0022.flat: Even simply looking at these odd rings gives way to a compulsion to wear two of them, despite all better judgement.

gear-accessory#0023.src: Give yourself to darkness, and in darkness, answers will take shape.
gear-accessory#0023.dst: Kendini karanlığa bırak; karanlıkta cevaplar şekillenecek.
gear-accessory#0023.flat: Give yourself to darkness, and in darkness, answers will take shape.

gear-accessory#0024.src: This bracelet is imbued with both the oppressive heat of the mesa sun and the embers of an extinguished corrupted flame. It is known to spontaneously ignite anything that touches it for too long.It's pulling towards something.
gear-accessory#0024.dst: Bu bilezik hem çorak yaylanın boğucu güneşinin sıcaklığını hem de sönmüş, yozlaşmış bir alevin közlerini taşır. Kendisine fazla uzun dokunan her şeyi kendiliğinden tutuşturduğu bilinir.Bir şeye doğru çekiliyor.
gear-accessory#0024.flat: This bracelet is imbued with both the oppressive heat of the mesa sun and the embers of an extinguished corrupted flame. It is known to spontaneously ignite anything that touches it for too long.It's pulling towards something.

gear-accessory#0025.src: An anomaly of destruction, for the conquerors who seek purpose outside of reality.
gear-accessory#0025.dst: Yıkımın bir anomalisi; amacını gerçekliğin dışında arayan fatihler için.
gear-accessory#0025.flat: An anomaly of destruction, for the conquerors who seek purpose outside of reality.

gear-accessory#0026.src: The silver looks rather tarnished...does he expect you to believe that "gem" isn't just a cheap glass bauble?
gear-accessory#0026.dst: Gümüş epey kararmış görünüyor... O "mücevherin" ucuz bir cam boncuk olmadığına inanmanı mı bekliyor?
gear-accessory#0026.flat: The silver looks rather tarnished...does he expect you to believe that "gem" isn't just a cheap glass bauble?

gear-accessory#0027.src: This bracelet is awarded to participants of the Legendary Challenge. Its modular design allows it to be upgraded in a number of different ways.
gear-accessory#0027.dst: Bu bilezik Legendary Challenge katılımcılarına verilir. Modüler tasarımı sayesinde birçok farklı şekilde geliştirilebilir.
gear-accessory#0027.flat: This bracelet is awarded to participants of the Legendary Challenge. Its modular design allows it to be upgraded in a number of different ways.

gear-accessory#0028.src: This necklace is awarded to participants of the Legendary Challenge. Its modular design allows it to be upgraded in a number of different ways.
gear-accessory#0028.dst: Bu kolye Legendary Challenge katılımcılarına verilir. Modüler tasarımı sayesinde birçok farklı şekilde geliştirilebilir.
gear-accessory#0028.flat: This necklace is awarded to participants of the Legendary Challenge. Its modular design allows it to be upgraded in a number of different ways.

gear-accessory#0029.src: This ring is awarded to participants of the Legendary Challenge. Its modular design allows it to be upgraded in a number of different ways.
gear-accessory#0029.dst: Bu yüzük Legendary Challenge katılımcılarına verilir. Modüler tasarımı sayesinde birçok farklı şekilde geliştirilebilir.
gear-accessory#0029.flat: This ring is awarded to participants of the Legendary Challenge. Its modular design allows it to be upgraded in a number of different ways.

gear-accessory#0030.src: A mighty, earth-shatteringly powerful weapon was destroyed for fear of its raw power, and the pieces buried. They were unearthed decades later, and were reforged into various items including this sturdy bracer.
gear-accessory#0030.dst: Ham gücünden korkulan, yeri yerinden oynatan kudretli bir silah yok edilmiş, parçaları gömülmüştü. On yıllar sonra çıkarılan parçalar, bu sağlam bileklik de dahil, çeşitli eşyalara dönüştürüldü.
gear-accessory#0030.flat: A mighty, earth-shatteringly powerful weapon was destroyed for fear of its raw power, and the pieces buried. They were unearthed decades later, and were reforged into various items including this sturdy bracer.

gear-accessory#0031.src: Let their souls sing your chorus of victory.
gear-accessory#0031.flat: Let their souls sing your chorus of victory.

gear-accessory#0032.src: Reverberating with the bravery and residual strength of fallen Wynn soldiers, every casualty only serves to harden the resolve it instills in the wearer.
gear-accessory#0032.dst: Düşmüş Wynn askerlerinin cesareti ve geride kalan gücüyle titreşir; her kayıp, takana verdiği kararlılığı yalnızca daha da çelikleştirir.
gear-accessory#0032.flat: Reverberating with the bravery and residual strength of fallen Wynn soldiers, every casualty only serves to harden the resolve it instills in the wearer.

gear-accessory#0033.src: There are little chips and cracks all over this... was someone trying to break it down for gold?
gear-accessory#0033.dst: Her yanında küçük kırıklar ve çatlaklar var... Biri bunu altını için parçalamaya mı çalışmış?
gear-accessory#0033.flat: There are little chips and cracks all over this... was someone trying to break it down for gold?

gear-accessory#0034.src: This bracelet holds a hastily scrawled diagram and message: tahkuhac ah pichul il nikckrah ceftif, necal cistodes il pahnikcredos. pulits pices il tahkuhac il pahnifkel sef icetlis pruts, hatl nec niftocos. tof il recnal toc rofmedos. nikcred kalkah, its kalahretsed nofmales uc las{#}ec tofsifos.
gear-accessory#0034.dst: Bu bilezikte aceleyle karalanmış bir çizim ve mesaj var: tahkuhac ah pichul il nikckrah ceftif, necal cistodes il pahnikcredos. pulits pices il tahkuhac il pahnifkel sef icetlis pruts, hatl nec niftocos. tof il recnal toc rofmedos. nikcred kalkah, its kalahretsed nofmales uc las{#}ec tofsifos.
gear-accessory#0034.flat: This bracelet holds a hastily scrawled diagram and message: tahkuhac ah pichul il nikckrah ceftif, necal cistodes il pahnikcredos. pulits pices il tahkuhac il pahnifkel sef icetlis pruts, hatl nec niftocos. tof il recnal toc rofmedos. nikcred kalkah, its kalahretsed nofmales uc lasec tofsifos.

gear-accessory#0035.src: Feeling the fresh chill of the cold air is all you need to know you're really alive.
gear-accessory#0035.dst: Soğuk havanın taze ayazını hissetmek, gerçekten yaşadığını anlamana yeter.
gear-accessory#0035.flat: Feeling the fresh chill of the cold air is all you need to know you're really alive.

gear-accessory#0036.src: An anomaly of adoption, for the caretakers who seek purpose outside of reality.
gear-accessory#0036.dst: Sahiplenmenin bir anomalisi; amacını gerçekliğin dışında arayan bakıcılar için.
gear-accessory#0036.flat: An anomaly of adoption, for the caretakers who seek purpose outside of reality.

gear-accessory#0037.src: "All of our faith, all of our worship, and we were rewarded with the apocalypse."
gear-accessory#0037.dst: "Bütün inancımız, bütün ibadetimiz... Ve ödülümüz kıyamet oldu."
gear-accessory#0037.flat: "All of our faith, all of our worship, and we were rewarded with the apocalypse."

gear-accessory#0038.src: The forger of this ring had to endure {~} long days of smelting various metals only found in the ocean. A single mistake would ruin the creation. The mystic metals are said to seep into the wearers skin to gently replenish their resolve.
gear-accessory#0038.dst: Bu yüzüğün ustası, yalnızca okyanusta bulunan çeşitli madenleri eritmek için {~} uzun güne katlanmak zorunda kaldı. Tek bir hata eseri mahvederdi. Mistik madenlerin takanın tenine sızarak kararlılığını usulca tazelediği söylenir.
gear-accessory#0038.flat: The forger of this ring had to endure {~} long days of smelting various metals only found in the ocean. A single mistake would ruin the creation. The mystic metals are said to seep into the wearers skin to gently replenish their resolve.
gear-accessory#0038._raw: The forger of this ring had to endure 30 long days of smelting various metals only found in the ocean. A single mistake would ruin the creation. The mystic metals are said to seep into the wearers skin to gently replenish their resolve.

gear-accessory#0039.src: The runes carved onto the gold beads strung along this simple necklace translate into various words meaning variance. It provides many abilities though unexplainable means.
gear-accessory#0039.dst: Bu sade kolyeye dizilmiş altın boncuklara kazınan rünler, değişkenlik anlamına gelen çeşitli kelimelere karşılık gelir. Açıklanamaz yollarla pek çok yetenek bahşeder.
gear-accessory#0039.flat: The runes carved onto the gold beads strung along this simple necklace translate into various words meaning variance. It provides many abilities though unexplainable means.

gear-accessory#0040.src: It looks like someone tried and failed to improve it. The re-smithing job was obviously rushed...
gear-accessory#0040.dst: Biri bunu geliştirmeye çalışıp başaramamış gibi görünüyor. Yeniden dövme işi belli ki aceleye getirilmiş...
gear-accessory#0040.flat: It looks like someone tried and failed to improve it. The re-smithing job was obviously rushed...

gear-accessory#0041.src: The dead are often burned to nullify the risk of return. For creatures of corruption, however, that fire can be enough for them to rise again.It's pulling towards something.
gear-accessory#0041.dst: Ölüler genellikle geri dönme tehlikesini ortadan kaldırmak için yakılır. Ama yozlaşmış yaratıklar için o ateş yeniden ayağa kalkmaya yetebilir.Bir şeye doğru çekiliyor.
gear-accessory#0041.flat: The dead are often burned to nullify the risk of return. For creatures of corruption, however, that fire can be enough for them to rise again.It's pulling towards something.

gear-accessory#0042.src: The mangled body found days too late apparently thought this necklace would let them traverse between geysers into the Upper Heights.
gear-accessory#0042.dst: Günler sonra, çok geç bulunan parçalanmış ceset, bu kolyenin kendisini gayzerler arasından Upper Heights'a taşıyacağını sanmış anlaşılan.
gear-accessory#0042.flat: The mangled body found days too late apparently thought this necklace would let them traverse between geysers into the Upper Heights.

gear-accessory#0043.src: Unspeakable things live within the shadows; waiting so patiently to take others into their ranks. Facsimiles of their existence, painted in inscrutable darkness. Nobody will see. Nobody will know. Nobody will remember.
gear-accessory#0043.dst: Gölgelerde ağza alınmayacak şeyler yaşar; başkalarını saflarına katmak için sabırla bekler. Varlıklarının kopyaları, anlaşılmaz bir karanlığa boyanmış. Kimse görmeyecek. Kimse bilmeyecek. Kimse hatırlamayacak.
gear-accessory#0043.flat: Unspeakable things live within the shadows; waiting so patiently to take others into their ranks. Facsimiles of their existence, painted in inscrutable darkness. Nobody will see. Nobody will know. Nobody will remember.

gear-accessory#0044.src: Stay calm and stay in control. The hardest fights cannot be won by chance alone.
gear-accessory#0044.dst: Sakin kal, kontrolü elinde tut. En zorlu dövüşler yalnızca şansla kazanılmaz.
gear-accessory#0044.flat: Stay calm and stay in control. The hardest fights cannot be won by chance alone.

gear-accessory#0045.src: An anomaly of separation, for the wanderers who seek purpose outside of reality.
gear-accessory#0045.dst: Ayrılığın bir anomalisi; amacını gerçekliğin dışında arayan gezginler için.
gear-accessory#0045.flat: An anomaly of separation, for the wanderers who seek purpose outside of reality.

gear-accessory#0046.src: Branded on your skin reads: "No refunds!"
gear-accessory#0046.flat: Branded on your skin reads: "No refunds!"

gear-accessory#0047.src: Desired by many of the countless challengers, this bracelet allows you to sense movements over thousands of meters away. It is decorated with rough yet beautiful jewels.
gear-accessory#0047.dst: Sayısız meydan okuyucunun arzuladığı bu bilezik, binlerce metre öteden hareketleri sezmeni sağlar. Kaba ama güzel mücevherlerle süslüdür.
gear-accessory#0047.flat: Desired by many of the countless challengers, this bracelet allows you to sense movements over thousands of meters away. It is decorated with rough yet beautiful jewels.

gear-accessory#0048.src: This ultimate version of a necklace was given to less than a handful of adventurers. Once on your neck, you can communicate with the ground below as if you grew roots.
gear-accessory#0048.dst: Bu kolyenin nihai sürümü bir avuçtan az maceracıya verildi. Boynuna taktığında, kök salmışçasına aşağıdaki toprakla konuşabilirsin.
gear-accessory#0048.flat: This ultimate version of a necklace was given to less than a handful of adventurers. Once on your neck, you can communicate with the ground below as if you grew roots.

gear-accessory#0049.src: This masterpiece of a ring utilizes powerful electromagic to expose its wearer to earth's heartbeat. Wearing it, you can feel a deep connection to the ground below.
gear-accessory#0049.dst: Bu başyapıt yüzük, güçlü elektrobüyüyle takanı toprağın kalp atışına açar. Taktığında aşağıdaki toprakla derin bir bağ hissedersin.
gear-accessory#0049.flat: This masterpiece of a ring utilizes powerful electromagic to expose its wearer to earth's heartbeat. Wearing it, you can feel a deep connection to the ground below.

gear-accessory#0050.src: This bracelet opens up its wearers spirit, filling it with pure elemental knowledge. The ornaments decorating it are without peer.
gear-accessory#0050.dst: Bu bilezik takanın ruhunu açar ve onu saf elementel bilgiyle doldurur. Üzerindeki süslerin eşi benzeri yoktur.
gear-accessory#0050.flat: This bracelet opens up its wearers spirit, filling it with pure elemental knowledge. The ornaments decorating it are without peer.

gear-accessory#0051.src: Unlike any other invention this necklace enhances your power and understanding of the elements tenfold. The colorful jewels used are almost dizzying you.
gear-accessory#0051.dst: Başka hiçbir icada benzemeyen bu kolye, gücünü ve elementleri kavrayışını on kat artırır. Kullanılan rengârenk mücevherler neredeyse başını döndürüyor.
gear-accessory#0051.flat: Unlike any other invention this necklace enhances your power and understanding of the elements tenfold. The colorful jewels used are almost dizzying you.

gear-accessory#0052.src: This mighty ring is the crown jewel amongst elemental rings. Wearing it, your knowledge is no longer limited to a few elements.
gear-accessory#0052.dst: Bu kudretli yüzük, elementel yüzüklerin göz bebeğidir. Taktığında bilgin artık birkaç elementle sınırlı kalmaz.
gear-accessory#0052.flat: This mighty ring is the crown jewel amongst elemental rings. Wearing it, your knowledge is no longer limited to a few elements.

gear-accessory#0053.src: You'll fight strong like the tide, the merchant said, and no word was a lie. With this bracelet on your arm you could ride a wave with your bare feet.
gear-accessory#0053.dst: Gelgit gibi güçlü savaşacaksın, demişti tüccar; tek kelimesi bile yalan değildi. Bu bilezik kolundayken çıplak ayakla dalga sörfü yapabilirdin.

gear-accessory#0101.dst: Bu eldiveni kalın bir kan ve et tabakası kaplıyor. Ona her göz attığında, ölümsüzler tarafından paramparça edildiğin görüntüler zihninde çakıyor ve ürperiyorsun.Bir şeye doğru çekiliyor.
gear-accessory#0101.flat: A thick layer of blood and gore coats this gauntlet. Every time you glance at it, images of being torn to pieces by the undead flash into your mind, and you shudder.It's pulling towards something.

gear-accessory#0102.src: Originally designed to jumpstart disabled war machines on the battlefield. However, when worn on the neck, it instead delivers high-voltage shocks directly into the jugular whenever any major movement is made.
gear-accessory#0102.dst: Aslen savaş alanında devre dışı kalan savaş makinelerini yeniden çalıştırmak için tasarlandı. Ama boyuna takılınca, her büyük harekette doğrudan şah damarına yüksek voltajlı şoklar veriyor.
gear-accessory#0102.flat: Originally designed to jumpstart disabled war machines on the battlefield. However, when worn on the neck, it instead delivers high-voltage shocks directly into the jugular whenever any major movement is made.

gear-accessory#0103.src: Two sides of the same coin.
gear-accessory#0103.flat: Two sides of the same coin.

gear-accessory#0104.src: Having felt the power of the Keep's hex, this jewel carries a familiar weight. Much like the Hex-Masters before you, you find channeling curses comes like second nature.
gear-accessory#0104.dst: Keep'in lanetinin gücünü tatmış bu mücevher tanıdık bir ağırlık taşıyor. Senden önceki Hex-Master'lar gibi, lanetleri yönlendirmek sana da ikinci doğan gibi geliyor.
gear-accessory#0104.flat: Having felt the power of the Keep's hex, this jewel carries a familiar weight. Much like the Hex-Masters before you, you find channeling curses comes like second nature.

gear-accessory#0105.src: Although the warlock's curse placed upon this simple, {p}-crafted charm will reduce the abilities of the wearer significantly, its original luck-bolstering properties still are in place.
gear-accessory#0105.dst: Bu sade, {p} yapımı tılsıma konan büyücü laneti takanın yeteneklerini epey azaltsa da şans artıran asıl özellikleri hâlâ yerinde.
gear-accessory#0105.flat: Although the warlock's curse placed upon this simple, {p}-crafted charm will reduce the abilities of the wearer significantly, its original luck-bolstering properties still are in place.
gear-accessory#0105._raw: Although the warlock's curse placed upon this simple, Olux-crafted charm will reduce the abilities of the wearer significantly, its original luck-bolstering properties still are in place.

gear-accessory#0106.src: Stability is not necessarily found in stasis, but predictability.
gear-accessory#0106.dst: İstikrar illa durağanlıkta değil, öngörülebilirlikte bulunur.
gear-accessory#0106.flat: Stability is not necessarily found in stasis, but predictability.

gear-accessory#0107.src: You stand at the top of the world, but the only way forward is down.
gear-accessory#0107.dst: Dünyanın zirvesinde duruyorsun, ama ileri giden tek yol aşağısı.
gear-accessory#0107.flat: You stand at the top of the world, but the only way forward is down.

gear-accessory#0108.src: You need to keep moving. You can't stop here. You can't. You can't breathe. You can't run. You're dying. You can't keep on. You can't. You can't.
gear-accessory#0108.dst: Devam etmelisin. Burada duramazsın. Duramazsın. Nefes alamıyorsun. Koşamıyorsun. Ölüyorsun. Devam edemezsin. Edemezsin. Edemezsin.
gear-accessory#0108.flat: You need to keep moving. You can't stop here. You can't. You can't breathe. You can't run. You're dying. You can't keep on. You can't. You can't.

gear-accessory#0109.src: "Doing it right" is a waste of time.
gear-accessory#0109.flat: "Doing it right" is a waste of time.

gear-accessory#0110.src: An anomaly of invasion, for the explorers who seek purpose outside of reality.
gear-accessory#0110.dst: İstilanın bir anomalisi; amacını gerçekliğin dışında arayan kâşifler için.
gear-accessory#0110.flat: An anomaly of invasion, for the explorers who seek purpose outside of reality.

gear-accessory#0111.src: The runes carved into this simple gold ring translate into various words meaning power. It amplifies elemental energies in inexplicable ways.
gear-accessory#0111.dst: Bu sade altın yüzüğe kazınan rünler, güç anlamına gelen çeşitli kelimelere karşılık gelir. Elementel enerjileri açıklanamaz yollarla güçlendirir.
gear-accessory#0111.flat: The runes carved into this simple gold ring translate into various words meaning power. It amplifies elemental energies in inexplicable ways.

gear-accessory#0112.src: A gift from Her Majesty to The Iron Commander in recognition of his accomplishments. If only he knew what it represented...
gear-accessory#0112.dst: Majesteleri'nin başarılarını takdiren Iron Commander'a hediyesi. Neyi temsil ettiğini bir bilseydi...
gear-accessory#0112.flat: A gift from Her Majesty to The Iron Commander in recognition of his accomplishments. If only he knew what it represented...

gear-accessory#0113.src: Tinkerers in the Roughworks often repeatedly augment obsolete parts in search of new innovations and capabilities. Their handiwork, an example of which rests upon your finger, compels you to continue the repetition and break new boundaries.
gear-accessory#0113.dst: Roughworks'teki tamirciler, yeni buluşlar ve yetenekler arayışıyla eskimiş parçaları tekrar tekrar geliştirir. Bir örneği parmağında duran el işleri, seni de tekrara devam etmeye ve yeni sınırlar aşmaya zorluyor.
gear-accessory#0113.flat: Tinkerers in the Roughworks often repeatedly augment obsolete parts in search of new innovations and capabilities. Their handiwork, an example of which rests upon your finger, compels you to continue the repetition and break new boundaries.

gear-accessory#0115.src: The cloth wraps produced by the canyon Dojo are just that, merely soft cloth. It is left to the users to apply them skillfully in battle, in whatever way they see fit.
gear-accessory#0115.dst: Kanyondaki Dojo'nun ürettiği kumaş sargılar tam da öyledir: yalnızca yumuşak kumaş. Onları savaşta ustaca, uygun gördükleri şekilde kullanmak takanlara kalmıştır.
gear-accessory#0115.flat: The cloth wraps produced by the canyon Dojo are just that, merely soft cloth. It is left to the users to apply them skillfully in battle, in whatever way they see fit.

gear-accessory#0116.src: A symbol of apology. Of pain, never intended but given carelessly. Of good intentions marred by thoughtlessness and overeager optimism. To give one of these icy pearls away is to give away part of yourself,  and to give hope to those you have hurt that they may find peace.
gear-accessory#0116.dst: Bir özür simgesi. Hiç istenmeden, ama dikkatsizce verilen acının. Düşüncesizlik ve aşırı hevesli iyimserlikle gölgelenmiş iyi niyetlerin. Bu buzdan incilerden birini vermek kendinden bir parça vermektir; incittiklerine huzur bulabilecekleri umudunu vermektir.
gear-accessory#0116.flat: A symbol of apology. Of pain, never intended but given carelessly. Of good intentions marred by thoughtlessness and overeager optimism. To give one of these icy pearls away is to give away part of yourself,  and to give hope to those you have hurt that they may find peace.

gear-accessory#0117.src: Gentle spirits of the wind attract themselves to the brilliant jewels slotted into this ring, bringing peace to its wearers and those around them.
gear-accessory#0117.dst: Rüzgârın nazik ruhları bu yüzüğe yerleştirilmiş parlak mücevherlere çekilir; takana ve çevresindekilere huzur getirir.
gear-accessory#0117.flat: Gentle spirits of the wind attract themselves to the brilliant jewels slotted into this ring, bringing peace to its wearers and those around them.

gear-accessory#0118.src: An old {p} saying is engraved along the metal. "A single toss of the knucklebones can make or break a gambling man."
gear-accessory#0118.dst: Metalin boyunca eski bir {p} sözü kazınmış: "Aşık kemiklerinin tek bir atışı, bir kumarbazı ya yapar ya yıkar."
gear-accessory#0118.flat: An old {p} saying is engraved along the metal. "A single toss of the knucklebones can make or break a gambling man."
gear-accessory#0118._raw: An old Nemract saying is engraved along the metal. "A single toss of the knucklebones can make or break a gambling man."

gear-accessory#0119.src: An uncountably old relic of {p} which has changed owners only through death, there is an inscription carved on it: 'eat or be eaten'
gear-accessory#0119.dst: {p} topraklarından kalma, sayısız yıllık bir kalıntı; sahip değiştirmesi yalnızca ölümle olmuştur. Üzerine bir yazı kazınmış: 'ye ya da yen'
gear-accessory#0119.flat: An uncountably old relic of {p} which has changed owners only through death, there is an inscription carved on it: 'eat or be eaten'
gear-accessory#0119._raw: An uncountably old relic of Time Valley which has changed owners only through death, there is an inscription carved on it: 'eat or be eaten'

gear-accessory#0120.src: This medallion marks its wearer as a true champion. It is awarded to those who have put an unnecessary amount of time into attempting the Legendary Challenge.
gear-accessory#0120.dst: Bu madalyon, takanı gerçek bir şampiyon olarak işaretler. Legendary Challenge için gereğinden fazla zaman harcamış olanlara verilir.
gear-accessory#0120.flat: This medallion marks its wearer as a true champion. It is awarded to those who have put an unnecessary amount of time into attempting the Legendary Challenge.

gear-accessory#0121.src: It turns out that having an acidic, slightly corrupted slime attached to your hands has benefits in combat... still, you should probably get that stuff taken off before it eats the flesh away from your fingerbones.It's pulling towards something.
gear-accessory#0121.dst: Görünen o ki ellerine yapışık asitli, biraz da yozlaşmış bir balçığın savaşta faydaları varmış... Yine de parmak kemiklerindeki eti yemeden şu şeyi çıkartsan iyi olur.Bir şeye doğru çekiliyor.
gear-accessory#0121.flat: It turns out that having an acidic, slightly corrupted slime attached to your hands has benefits in combat... still, you should probably get that stuff taken off before it eats the flesh away from your fingerbones.It's pulling towards something.

gear-accessory#0122.src: The magical oddity known as lodestone has been studied for years as an active counterpart to quartz's passive magical properties. Research continues, but it is valuable when creating magical items.
gear-accessory#0122.dst: Mıknatıs taşı olarak bilinen büyülü tuhaflık, kuvarsın edilgen büyü özelliklerinin etkin bir karşılığı olarak yıllardır inceleniyor. Araştırmalar sürüyor, ama büyülü eşya yapımında değerlidir.
gear-accessory#0122.flat: The magical oddity known as lodestone has been studied for years as an active counterpart to quartz's passive magical properties. Research continues, but it is valuable when creating magical items.

gear-accessory#0123.src: This ring is set with a beautiful, mesmerizing gem. You could look at it for hours. Hours and hours and hours.
gear-accessory#0123.dst: Bu yüzüğe güzel, büyüleyici bir taş oturtulmuş. Saatlerce bakabilirsin. Saatlerce ve saatlerce ve saatlerce.
gear-accessory#0123.flat: This ring is set with a beautiful, mesmerizing gem. You could look at it for hours. Hours and hours and hours.

gear-accessory#0124.src: You can hardly notice some text engraved on this bracelet. Looking closer, the worn-out inscriptions are telling the legends of an ancient hero whom you do not know of.
gear-accessory#0124.dst: Bu bileziğe kazınmış yazıyı zar zor fark ediyorsun. Yakından bakınca, aşınmış yazıtların tanımadığın kadim bir kahramanın efsanelerini anlattığını görüyorsun.
gear-accessory#0124.flat: You can hardly notice some text engraved on this bracelet. Looking closer, the worn-out inscriptions are telling the legends of an ancient hero whom you do not know of.

gear-accessory#0125.src: Carved from a deep-sea gemstone laced with arcane wards, this pendant twists malevolent stares back upon their source, leaving the bearer unscathed.
gear-accessory#0125.dst: Gizemli korumalarla örülmüş bir derin deniz taşından oyulan bu kolye, kötü bakışları sahibine geri çevirir ve taşıyanı zarar görmeden bırakır.
gear-accessory#0125.flat: Carved from a deep-sea gemstone laced with arcane wards, this pendant twists malevolent stares back upon their source, leaving the bearer unscathed.

gear-accessory#0126.src: A recently married man went off to war wearing this wedding ring. Though he perished in battle, his courage and determination empowers all who wear it.
gear-accessory#0126.dst: Yeni evlenmiş bir adam bu nikâh yüzüğüyle savaşa gitti. Savaşta can verse de cesareti ve kararlılığı onu takan herkese güç verir.
gear-accessory#0126.flat: A recently married man went off to war wearing this wedding ring. Though he perished in battle, his courage and determination empowers all who wear it.

gear-accessory#0127.src: The stellar quality of the coral jewels set into the ring comes from a magical purification process, involving a decade-long soak in mystical Gylia water.
gear-accessory#0127.dst: Yüzüğe oturtulmuş mercan mücevherlerin olağanüstü kalitesi, mistik Gylia suyunda on yıl bekletilmeyi içeren büyülü bir arındırma işleminden gelir.
gear-accessory#0127.flat: The stellar quality of the coral jewels set into the ring comes from a magical purification process, involving a decade-long soak in mystical Gylia water.

gear-accessory#0128.src: Although not truly magical by any means, the sheer craftsmanship of this ornate broach makes its wearers feel skillful.
gear-accessory#0128.dst: Hiçbir açıdan gerçekten büyülü olmasa da bu süslü broşun eşsiz işçiliği takanlarına kendilerini usta hissettirir.
gear-accessory#0128.flat: Although not truly magical by any means, the sheer craftsmanship of this ornate broach makes its wearers feel skillful.

gear-accessory#0130.src: What you have seen will mark you forever.
gear-accessory#0130.flat: What you have seen will mark you forever.

gear-accessory#0131.src: The sun fears its wings, and so shall your enemies.
gear-accessory#0131.dst: Güneş onun kanatlarından korkar; düşmanların da korkacak.
gear-accessory#0131.flat: The sun fears its wings, and so shall your enemies.

gear-accessory#0132.src: It's completely impossible to use this for its intended purpose now. It barely can fit on your finger as is.
gear-accessory#0132.dst: Bunu amacına uygun kullanmak artık tamamen imkânsız. Haliyle parmağına bile zor sığıyor.
gear-accessory#0132.flat: It's completely impossible to use this for its intended purpose now. It barely can fit on your finger as is.

gear-accessory#0133.src: This golden cuff has an odd time dilation effect surrounding it, slowing all movements significantly, but multiplying the force of impact to a significant degree.
gear-accessory#0133.dst: Bu altın bilekliği tuhaf bir zaman genleşmesi sarıyor; bütün hareketleri epey yavaşlatıyor ama darbenin kuvvetini kayda değer ölçüde katlıyor.
gear-accessory#0133.flat: This golden cuff has an odd time dilation effect surrounding it, slowing all movements significantly, but multiplying the force of impact to a significant degree.

gear-accessory#0134.src: Some of the many superstitions floating around the Fruman redwoods surround the reflective stone of this necklace. Those who stare at it claim to see a twisted version of themselves staring back, one that amplifies the deepest shortcomings of the viewers' souls.
gear-accessory#0134.dst: Fruma kızılçamları arasında dolaşan pek çok batıl inancın bazıları bu kolyenin yansıtıcı taşı etrafında döner. Ona bakanlar, kendilerine bakan çarpık bir benlik gördüklerini söyler; bakanın ruhundaki en derin kusurları büyüten bir benlik.
gear-accessory#0134.flat: Some of the many superstitions floating around the Fruman redwoods surround the reflective stone of this necklace. Those who stare at it claim to see a twisted version of themselves staring back, one that amplifies the deepest shortcomings of the viewers' souls.

gear-accessory#0135.src: Upon the death of a mummy, the curse it inflicts is lifted. Despite the mummy's defeat, its mad shrieks still pierce your ears in moments otherwise tranquil.It's pulling towards something.
gear-accessory#0135.dst: Bir mumya ölünce verdiği lanet kalkar. Ama mumya yenilmiş olsa da çılgın çığlıkları, aksi halde huzurlu anlarında bile kulaklarını deliyor.Bir şeye doğru çekiliyor.
gear-accessory#0135.flat: Upon the death of a mummy, the curse it inflicts is lifted. Despite the mummy's defeat, its mad shrieks still pierce your ears in moments otherwise tranquil.It's pulling towards something.

gear-accessory#0137.src: Sealed away by the Avos of the old days to prevent it from falling into the wrong hands, this necklace was enchanted to strengthen its wearers spiritual link to nature itself.
gear-accessory#0137.dst: Eski günlerin Avos'u, yanlış ellere düşmesin diye bu kolyeyi mühürledi; takanın doğanın kendisiyle ruhsal bağını güçlendirmek için büyülenmişti.
gear-accessory#0137.flat: Sealed away by the Avos of the old days to prevent it from falling into the wrong hands, this necklace was enchanted to strengthen its wearers spiritual link to nature itself.

gear-accessory#0138.src: "The protector will keep us safe even after this! It has to, it must, it-"
gear-accessory#0138.dst: "Koruyucu bundan sonra bile bizi koruyacak! Korumak zorunda, mecbur, o-"
gear-accessory#0138.flat: "The protector will keep us safe even after this! It has to, it must, it-"

gear-accessory#0139.src: Found on the corpse of the oldest shopkeeper of the Gavel province, the engraved text reads 'GREED'.
gear-accessory#0139.dst: Gavel eyaletinin en yaşlı dükkâncısının cesedinde bulundu; kazınmış yazı 'AÇGÖZLÜLÜK' diyor.
gear-accessory#0139.flat: Found on the corpse of the oldest shopkeeper of the Gavel province, the engraved text reads 'GREED'.

gear-accessory#0142.src: The jewels in this necklace naturally draw darkness and corruption into its wearer, purifying the land around them at the cost of their own life.
gear-accessory#0142.dst: Bu kolyedeki mücevherler karanlığı ve yozlaşmayı doğal olarak takana çeker; kendi canı pahasına çevresindeki toprağı arındırır.
gear-accessory#0142.flat: The jewels in this necklace naturally draw darkness and corruption into its wearer, purifying the land around them at the cost of their own life.

gear-accessory#0143.src: Your mind is falling apart, the pieces scattering, your grasp on reality weakening, your soul an empty space. I shall fill it.
gear-accessory#0143.dst: Zihnin dağılıyor, parçalar saçılıyor, gerçekliğe tutunuşun zayıflıyor, ruhun bomboş bir boşluk. Onu ben dolduracağım.
gear-accessory#0143.flat: Your mind is falling apart, the pieces scattering, your grasp on reality weakening, your soul an empty space. I shall fill it.

gear-accessory#0144.src: A strange magic attracts you to this ring. Maybe you shouldn't tell anyone about its existence?
gear-accessory#0144.dst: Tuhaf bir büyü seni bu yüzüğe çekiyor. Varlığından kimseye bahsetmesen mi acaba?
gear-accessory#0144.flat: A strange magic attracts you to this ring. Maybe you shouldn't tell anyone about its existence?

gear-accessory#0145.src: The jewel on this ring is found very rarely deep beneath the {p}. It has the power to manipulate light itself.
gear-accessory#0145.dst: Bu yüzükteki taş, {p} derinliklerinde çok nadir bulunur. Işığın kendisini yönlendirme gücü vardır.
gear-accessory#0145.flat: The jewel on this ring is found very rarely deep beneath the {p}. It has the power to manipulate light itself.
gear-accessory#0145._raw: The jewel on this ring is found very rarely deep beneath the Light Forest. It has the power to manipulate light itself.

gear-accessory#0146.src: Before the first breath was drawn from the open air, there was the slow, pulsing warmth of the deep. To walk the earth is to invite suffering into brittle bones, trading an eternal sanctuary for a world of choking dust and the aimless howling of the wind.
gear-accessory#0146.dst: Açık havadan ilk nefes çekilmeden önce, derinliklerin ağır, zonklayan sıcaklığı vardı. Yeryüzünde yürümek kırılgan kemiklere acıyı davet etmektir; sonsuz bir sığınağı boğucu toz ve rüzgârın amaçsız uğultusuyla dolu bir dünyaya değişmektir.
gear-accessory#0146.flat: Before the first breath was drawn from the open air, there was the slow, pulsing warmth of the deep. To walk the earth is to invite suffering into brittle bones, trading an eternal sanctuary for a world of choking dust and the aimless howling of the wind.

gear-accessory#0147.src: Your success heralds the beginning of something new.
gear-accessory#0147.dst: Başarın yeni bir şeyin başlangıcını müjdeliyor.
gear-accessory#0147.flat: Your success heralds the beginning of something new.

gear-accessory#0148.src: The runes carved into this simple gold cuff translate into various words meaning mastery. It amplifies the ability of the wearer in mysterious ways.
gear-accessory#0148.dst: Bu sade altın bilekliğe kazınan rünler, ustalık anlamına gelen çeşitli kelimelere karşılık gelir. Takanın yeteneğini gizemli yollarla güçlendirir.
gear-accessory#0148.flat: The runes carved into this simple gold cuff translate into various words meaning mastery. It amplifies the ability of the wearer in mysterious ways.

gear-accessory#0203.src: The lights slowly begin to wink out, one by one. You don't have much time left at all.
gear-accessory#0203.dst: Işıklar teker teker yavaşça sönmeye başlıyor. Hiç vaktin kalmadı sayılır.
gear-accessory#0203.flat: The lights slowly begin to wink out, one by one. You don't have much time left at all.

gear-accessory#0204.src: You're seeing double. Perhaps that's because there's more than one reality there.
gear-accessory#0204.dst: Çift görüyorsun. Belki de orada birden fazla gerçeklik olduğu içindir.
gear-accessory#0204.flat: You're seeing double. Perhaps that's because there's more than one reality there.

gear-accessory#0205.src: Her trial was rigged from the start. She deserved no justice for the things they claimed she did. The prison is her world now, the burden on her soul matched now only by the weight of the iron chain around her neck.
gear-accessory#0205.dst: Davası en başından hileliydi. Yaptığı iddia edilen şeyler için adalet görmeyi hak etmedi. Artık dünyası hapishane; ruhundaki yükle ancak boynundaki demir zincirin ağırlığı boy ölçüşebilir.
gear-accessory#0205.flat: Her trial was rigged from the start. She deserved no justice for the things they claimed she did. The prison is her world now, the burden on her soul matched now only by the weight of the iron chain around her neck.

gear-accessory#0206.src: Rumors circulate of a once-cook from {p} who managed to achieve the perfect meal. In their final days, they preserved its essence in this necklace, in a hope that someone else would be able to share the experience they had.
gear-accessory#0206.dst: {p} kökenli eski bir aşçının mükemmel yemeği yapmayı başardığı söylentisi dolaşıyor. Son günlerinde, yaşadığı deneyimi bir başkası da tadabilsin umuduyla onun özünü bu kolyede saklamış.
gear-accessory#0206.flat: Rumors circulate of a once-cook from {p} who managed to achieve the perfect meal. In their final days, they preserved its essence in this necklace, in a hope that someone else would be able to share the experience they had.
gear-accessory#0206._raw: Rumors circulate of a once-cook from Lutho who managed to achieve the perfect meal. In their final days, they preserved its essence in this necklace, in a hope that someone else would be able to share the experience they had.

gear-accessory#0207.src: It doesn't matter that you meant well.
gear-accessory#0207.dst: İyi niyetli olman bir şey değiştirmiyor.
gear-accessory#0207.flat: It doesn't matter that you meant well.

gear-accessory#0208.src: The wielders of this cursed glassen bauble are rendered mute. The effect is reversed after the item is removed, but the longer it is worn, the longer the curse remains.
gear-accessory#0208.dst: Bu lanetli cam süsü taşıyanlar dilsiz kalır. Eşya çıkarılınca etki tersine döner, ama ne kadar uzun takılırsa lanet o kadar uzun sürer.
gear-accessory#0208.flat: The wielders of this cursed glassen bauble are rendered mute. The effect is reversed after the item is removed, but the longer it is worn, the longer the curse remains.

gear-accessory#0209.src: It looks more like a dog paw to you, but you don't feel like risking your life arguing with the merchant.
gear-accessory#0209.dst: Sana daha çok köpek patisi gibi görünüyor, ama tüccarla tartışıp canını tehlikeye atmak istemiyorsun.
gear-accessory#0209.flat: It looks more like a dog paw to you, but you don't feel like risking your life arguing with the merchant.

gear-accessory#0212.src: Stackpeak hawks are known for their aggression towards adventurers approching their nests. However, under the hawks' hostility lies the instincts to protect the younglings from invaders.
gear-accessory#0212.dst: Stackpeak şahinleri yuvalarına yaklaşan maceracılara saldırganlıklarıyla bilinir. Ama şahinlerin düşmanlığının altında, yavrularını istilacılardan koruma içgüdüsü yatar.
gear-accessory#0212.flat: Stackpeak hawks are known for their aggression towards adventurers approching their nests. However, under the hawks' hostility lies the instincts to protect the younglings from invaders.

gear-accessory#0213.src: Your world crumbles around you even as your senses heighten. Get out while you still can.
gear-accessory#0213.dst: Duyuların keskinleşirken dünyan etrafında çöküyor. Hâlâ fırsatın varken kaç.
gear-accessory#0213.flat: Your world crumbles around you even as your senses heighten. Get out while you still can.

gear-accessory#0214.src: "They say the eyes are the windows to the soul. That's ridiculous, ocular fluids are primarily opaque." -Ragon, Elemental Researcher
gear-accessory#0214.dst: "Gözler ruhun penceresidir derler. Saçmalık, göz sıvıları çoğunlukla opaktır." -Ragon, Element Araştırmacısı
gear-accessory#0214.flat: "They say the eyes are the windows to the soul. That's ridiculous, ocular fluids are primarily opaque." -Ragon, Elemental Researcher

gear-accessory#0215.src: Soldiers claim that the sounds of undead hordes are one of the most feared things to hear across Wynn. Wearing this ring, the gruesome cries of corrupted legions permanently echo throughout your mind.It's pulling towards something.
gear-accessory#0215.dst: Askerler, ölümsüz sürülerin seslerinin Wynn'de duyulabilecek en korkunç şeylerden biri olduğunu söyler. Bu yüzüğü taktığında, yozlaşmış lejyonların dehşet verici çığlıkları zihninde durmadan yankılanır.Bir şeye doğru çekiliyor.
gear-accessory#0215.flat: Soldiers claim that the sounds of undead hordes are one of the most feared things to hear across Wynn. Wearing this ring, the gruesome cries of corrupted legions permanently echo throughout your mind.It's pulling towards something.

gear-accessory#0217.src: The world is a blur around you. The swirls of colour interweave and blend to an amalgam of light in every direction. The worst thing you can do is stop.

gear-accessory#0217.flat: The world is a blur around you. The swirls of colour interweave and blend to an amalgam of light in every direction. The worst thing you can do is stop.

gear-accessory#0221.src: Your flesh is but a weak imitation of power, a flabby welter of gushing blood and brittle bones, stitched together with threads of weak hope. There is only one way through: you must supplant your failing heart.
gear-accessory#0221.dst: Etin, gücün zayıf bir taklidinden ibaret; zayıf umut ipleriyle dikilmiş, fışkıran kan ve kırılgan kemiklerden oluşan pörsük bir yığın. Tek bir çıkış yolu var: tükenen kalbinin yerine başkasını koymalısın.
